name: London Film and Comic Con
blurb: Showmasters' autograph-and-photo convention at Olympia London, with film, TV and comic-creator guests across a weekend.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'Showmasters London Film & Comic Con returns to Olympia in 2027! Taking place on Saturday 14th & Sunday 15th August 2027' and 'Opening times Saturday 14th August 2027 - 9am to 7pm Sunday 15th August 2027 - 9am to 6pm'.

notes: Guest names and roles came from the homepage's 'Film & TV Guests' and 'Comic Guests' lists, each name individually linked to its own /guest/<slug>/ detail page, which is strong confirmation of identity. The dedicated guest-grid pages (guests-main/, guests-film-tv/, guests-comic-creators/, guests-trading-cards/, guests-cosplay/) render each photo without alt text or a caption that extract.mjs can read, and the trading-cards/cosplay category pages returned the same generic placeholder-sized grid with no distinguishing content, so no photo could be safely matched to a name - recorded as textOnlyGuests (22 names: 11 film/TV, 11 comic creators) rather than risk pairing the wrong face with a name; the build step can look up photos by name instead. Known-for left blank for names with no credit I could confirm. Ticket link is the site's own current 'BUY TICKETS' Eventbrite collection, which is still labelled '...2026-4796872' even though the event itself is 2027. Verify pass (2026-10-05): current -- the homepage's own <title> is 'London Film And Comic Con - 14th & 15th August 2027' and its 'MEET THE STARS' name list sits in the same hero text block as the 'returns to Olympia in 2027!' line; an independent web search corroborates Neve McIntosh, Colin Baker and Dan Starkey as reported guests for the 2027 edition, so the textOnlyGuests list stands.
